gaps.userNeed: I need my mobile editing environment to faithfully preserve and expose the custom site structure, categories, and templates I configured on desktop.
gaps.explanation: Mobile creators rely on established desktop taxonomies and site templates to maintain site organization while editing on the go. When desktop categories disappear or templates are uneditable in mobile, the user's workflow breaks and they are forced back to desktop. The app needs full taxonomy sync and template awareness to serve mobile-first managers effectively.

gaps.userNeed: I need explicit control over when my changes save and a reliable undo mechanism so I can edit risk-free on my phone.
gaps.explanation: Aggressive automatic saving combined with touch-screen missteps creates fear of permanently overwriting live or draft content. Users require clear save checkpoints and granular local undo/redo capabilities before changes auto-sync to the server. Providing explicit draft history control builds user trust and confidence during mobile post creation.
gaps.confidenceJustification: 85% — supported by detailed user feedback regarding anxiety from aggressive auto-saving and missing undo capabilities, combined with closed roadmap issues that only tackled button confirmation rather than edit state safety.
gaps.verdictReason: The development team closed issue #21189 considering undo feedback addressed, failing to recognize the deeper user need for complete non-destructive post revision and state control.
